name: Death Gaze
description: When a creature that can see the creature’s eyes starts its turn within 30 feet of the creature, the creature can force it to make a DC 13 Constitution saving throw if the creature isn’t incapacitated and can see the creature. If the saving throw fails by 5 or more, the creature is reduced to 0 hit points unless it is immune to the frightened condition. Otherwise, a creature takes 16 (3d10) psychic damage on a failed save. Unless surprised, a creature can avert its eyes to avoid the saving throw at the start of its turn. If the creature does so, it has disadvantage on attack rolls against the creature until the start of its next turn. If the creature looks at the creature in the meantime, that creature must immediately make the saving throw.
